column5: The three stored official trial routes were attempted natively and via the exact permissible Web route; two independently returned 404 and one could not be read. Targeted Oklahoma State search found veterinary jobs instead of an oncology enrollment roster. Current nonrecruitment cannot be inferred.

Native site failed; exact Web domain returned 502 and trial route could not be read. EVVIVAX separately continues to name its Pisa/New York collaboration but its telomerase/HER2 trial list has no distinct current VOS owner-intake site. Keep cat Tel-eVax archived and VOS source unresolved.

Actual current Web alternate for the same official chapter news URL displays an empty news module; this is a news index, not a recruiting roster or evidence closing any study. The individual oncology-news route is accounted separately.

No recruiting lead on the accessible chapter news index. The exact historical oncology-news leaf gives server error natively and via Web; the recorded document-library fallback is covered by an exact no-retry restriction. No recruitment roster claim.

The veterinary page describes earlier animal pilots with spontaneous tumors and preclinical work on Elenagen. Completed phase/adjoining US trial navigation refers to the oncology development program; there is no veterinary patient intake or newly named recruiting protocol on this page.

The CRO clinical-studies page and home/managed-access materials market infrastructure and broad pathways. No named recruiting canine/feline oncology study or protocol-level intervention and site is published on these routes.

Current institution page describes recruitment for palliative limb stabilization with injectable bone cement, with intake visit covered; goal is pain and stabilization, no tumor-directed treatment. Exact canonical record already excluded from matching; get calendar only for separately specified supportive-care watch.

Researcher page explicitly closes reovirus trial, and labels basic PD-1/CD20 program ongoing as of 2024. Hospital registry still describes anti-CD20. Current dated 2026 multisite anti-PD1 oral melanoma is a specific protocol; do not treat the old broad program as expansion. Check all named-current local and network contacts and dates.

UFPel project u10335 (Oct 31 2025–Feb 28 2027) plans 40 dogs receiving bleomycin ECT or calcium electroporation via HCV-UFPel oncology. Specific protocol, but currently open clinical screening, owner link and financial terms are not published in the project entry; journal/other university official links checked or queued separately.

Current sponsor describes development of BTX001 and cites previously treated dogs with bladder cancer. Prior published safety/efficacy and claimed benefit are not new enrollment. Crosswalk Dutch partner product by construct and paper, without making a registry or active intake claim.

Stored 2023 FIDO flyer URL now redirects to Adelaide cancer/health college content with no canine trial protocol. Do not treat current human trial education as FIDO patient recruitment; named study needs current institution-specific route.

Current sponsor describes VCB-2401 approved adjunct product with surgery/mammary tumors or chemotherapy/lymphoma. Feline-development intent is not a published trial. Existing commercial watch records stay outside trial matcher.

2016 flyer requests cats with GI lymphoma, excludes extra-GI disease and says it is comparing lymphoma subtypes. Long-lived exact same flyer is not a fresh 2026 therapeutic enrollment proof. Finish review of current hospital official fallback and look for same protocol status/publications.

SLU project and investigator profile describe oral karonudib across lymphoma, splenic HSA and mammary tumors; Brazilian FAPESP fellowship scope is distinct evidence, not a Brazilian enrollment site. Complete trial-specific owner-route search before classifying external blocker; no active match from grant dates.

Master and public archive describe SASH research generally, no open companion animal oncology patient protocol with intake and criteria. Do not include service navigation or general innovation articles as trials.

Master clearly presents post-splenectomy splenic HSA combined immunotherapy/chemotherapy at MediPaws as its only cancer item; stone and anesthesia renal studies excluded. Direct detail remains under exact prior restriction; no new readable funding/eligibility or Melbourne enrollment evidence claimed. Keep the current linked canonical intake scope.

PET-CT OSA and tigilanol STS both completed in primary text. Lymphosarcoma half-body irradiation page and owner leaflet require date cross-check; prostate page is clinical care and the separately named SCC project requires disposition.

Current clinical master names three active entries: gold photothermal, superficial canine SCC carboplatin, and local Therajan EGFR/HER2. Paccal dog/cat and lymphoma dose finding are closed; gilvetmab addition to carboplatin/EGFR specifically closed, not the entire sponsor study. TLR7/8/9 and FMT/Palladia remain Coming Soon. Footer mentions AT-014 and Immunocidin but has no directly usable active links. Verify each against sponsor and archive for any current BARC cohort.

Exact Bellingham/Aurelius–Lytix pilot clearly recruiting previously untreated stage III–V(a) canine B-cell lymphoma. Experimental oncolytic peptide plus adoptive unmodified T cells, three consecutive initial days and at least two follow-ups; sponsor calls participation fully funded and names Theresa Westfall. General paid adoptive-cell service page is separate. No printed date cutoff.

iCAT describes feline PD-1 and anti-CD20, with CAR-T in preparation. One linked public detailed hospital address is restricted. Reconcile dated partner notices and outcomes with the distinct dog and cat canonical identities instead of claiming a complete Japan-site roster from the research page.

VCCS official owner page displays one current Therajan/Yale EGFR/HER2 treatment study, same two doses from approved sponsor and local mobile cohort, not a separate drug trial. Confirms referral/consultation paths, two vaccines 3–4 weeks apart, vaccine free but owner-paid visits and associated fees. No published date cutoff; allocation is local to Fairfield/Westchester.

September 3 2025 Evergreen hospital protocol invitation for inhaled IL-15 in melanoma and osteosarcoma with lung metastases names mailing/telephone route and prior review. Current Chinese publication remains available; no newer dated indication found in official targeted NTU/Evergreen search. No fresh proof of which slots are open or owner expenses beyond the historic notice.

Actual current master has oral BI705564, feline high-grade GI WART with COP/Dox, pulmonary-carcinoma gilvetmab and LEAH CD20+ xCAR-T; all are existing precise records. Thyroid NIS is not assigned anticancer treatment. Still-printed COTC033 line maps to exact VCT24005785 Completed, not accepted as current; older historical gaps do not create a fifth treatment.

All eight linked primary brochures opened; scanned brochures were OCRed. Includes combined-therapy master, CAR neutrophils 6, ferumoxytol 7, CPMV 1, histotripsy 2, CRT-NP 3, carboplatin 4 and individual compassionate pathway 5. Check AVMA closed status/title scope and catheter/eligibility conflicts across individual dossiers. Umbrella says dogs/cats; no feline expansion from header alone.

University posted both canine mammary and inflammatory mammary cancer notices April 20 2021. No contemporaneous 2026 treatment enrollment update or cutoff from either lead; both phone/email links describe general clinical appointment eligibility, not proof the older research cohort is still recruiting.

Aúna's public oncology study information advises how trials work and invites general inquiry; no specific study intervention, eligibility, start status or named participating roster appears. No trial activated from clinical information page.

Primary institute's 2023 Perth study report identifies actual dogs with STS treated with injectable gel, but no dated current protocol enrollment or owner intake. Check current institute/cohost result or continuation before classifying external.

Maeda lab news describes completed sorafenib UCC results; it is not the actively listed IDO1 UCC protocol. Tokyo TCC poster has no extractable native/Web text; do not use it to broaden the applicant disease or recruitment criteria. Current Tokyo owner research roster is a separately inventoried source.
